name: Turkish Pilaf III
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ½ cup cold cooked chicken cut in dice

steps: Cook rice in boiling salted water, drain, and pour over hot water to thoroughly rinse.
Heat omelet pan, add butter, and as soon as butter is melted add rice.
Cook three minutes; then add tomatoes, chicken, and enough stock to moisten.
Cook five minutes, and season highly with salt and cayenne.
If not rich enough, add more butter.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
